reviews.snippet:
I visited Ruban Hospital recently hoping to get treatment under the Ayushman Bharat scheme, but unfortunately, they do not accept the Ayushman card. This is very disappointing, especially since many other hospitals in Patna are part of the Ayushman Bharat panel and provide good care to poor and middle-class patients.
Ruban is a well-known private hospital, and it is surprising that such a reputed hospital is not supporting a central government health scheme meant for the benefit of the public. Patients who genuinely need financial support are left helpless

reviews.snippet:
I admitted my wife for treatment for kidney stone and gallbladder stones under Ayushman yojana.I was quiet happy to see clean and good environment.  Staff nurses and doctors behaved as they behaved other patient. They don't distinguished between  Ayushman  and other patient.
Thank you all doctors and staff and nurses.
